<page>
 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0011
 Sarah Walters, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
10-2-24
Counsel for defendant:
Marilyn Fox, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant, by and through its undersigned counsel, files this Original Answer to Plaintiff's Original Petition and
respectfully shows the Court as follows.
Pursuant to Rule 92 of the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure, Defendant generally denies each and every allegation
contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence as
required by the Constitution and laws of the State of Texas.
For further answer, and without assmuing any burden of proof that the law places on Plaintiff, Defendant asserts the
flolowing affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's own negligence proximately caused or contributed to the collision at issue. Plaintiff failed to yield the
right-of-way at the intersection, failed to keep a proper lookout, and falied to maintain reasonable control of the
vehicle. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practcie and Remedies Code, any recovery must be reduced by
Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility, and Plaintiff may be barred entirely if that percentage exceeds fifty percent.
Second, the injuries and damages claimed were caused, in whole or in part, by a preexisting or unrelated condition,
or by a subsequent event, and not by the collision. Defendant is not liable for such damages.
Third, Plaintiff has failed to mitigate damages, including by failing to follow reasonable medical advice and by
incurring medical expenses that were unreasonable or unnecessary. Defendant reserves the right to seek a credit or
reduction for any amounts paid or payable by a collateral source to the extent permitted by Texas Civil Practice and
Remedies Code Section 41.0105.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this Answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
